Messages.Author: Alexis McCann
Messages.Body:
i'm in combat with anvil and he maneuvers to long range and
then fires a sewer lid at me. ouch! i flap in the air with
my hand or shoot some useless gesture at him. he pays for
2 added strikes (blur?) and throws 2 more lids at me.

i've seen restrictions on playing the same reaction or
modifier cards on one action but have not seen anything
pertaining to multiple strike cards of the same type.

anybody know for sure?

thanks.

chris hanson
swarthmore, pa

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Alexis McCann <mcc...@ben.dev.upenn.edu> wrote:
> i'm in combat with anvil and he maneuvers to long range and
> then fires a sewer lid at me. ouch! i flap in the air with
> my hand or shoot some useless gesture at him. he pays for
> 2 added strikes (blur?) and throws 2 more lids at me.

> i've seen restrictions on playing the same reaction or
> modifier cards on one action but have not seen anything
> pertaining to multiple strike cards of the same type.

Each strike card is only good for one strike. Anvil can do this, but
only if he has three Sewer Lid cards to play. This could be starting
the round with all three, starting with one and happening to draw a new
Sewer Lid each time one was thrown, or something in between.

Minions can play as many copies of a specific card each combat (and each
round) as they want, given the opportunity to do so.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
